The '''Goroth system''' was a binary [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
The Goroth system was one of a dozen [[Star system/Legends|systems]] within the [[Trans-Nebular Zone]] of the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]]. As the [[Vestor Pulsar]] made this whole area a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] "dead zone", traveling was rather difficult. The system could usually be reached with two- or three-leg jumps. From the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], Goroth could be reach with a three-leg route within twelve days or with a faster, more dangerous two-leg jump within ten days. The closest system was the [[Baylin Cluster/Legends|Baylin Cluster]], 14 hours away, while the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] capital, [[Milarian]], was 22 hours away.<ref name="GSE" />

The system had two [[Star/Legends|suns]]: [[Goroth Alpha]], a standard, main-sequence red-orange star, most commonly referred to as "the sun" or "K'Len" by the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]]. The second star was [[Goroth Beta]], a brown dwarf at the most outward orbital position. The system had four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], one of them, [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] having spawned sentient life.<ref name="GSE" />

==Orbital bodies==
===Oris===
{{Main|Oris}}
The closest of the planets to Goroth Alpha, Oris was [[nickel]]-[[Iron/Legends|iron]]-rock asteroid, captured by the sun. Relatively small, it was completely lifeless and had an orbit of 2.6 light minutes.<ref name="GSE" />

===Goroth Prime===
{{Main|Goroth Prime/Legends}}
The only inhabited planet with sentient life in the system orbiting at 7.1 light minutes,<ref name="GSE" /> it was once a pleasant terrestrial world with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The native [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] evolved relatively late and became members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] around 7,500 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Goroth was devastated during the [[Corellian/Aqualish war]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] when the Gorothites tried to play both sides against each other. Believed to be a volcanic wasteland for the next few millennia, the world was rediscovered during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

===Deneva===
{{Main|Denava}}
A [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with a perihelion orbit of 40.7 light minutes, Deneva had a low density and a small, solid core. The planet was inhabited by non-intelligent gasbag-like creatures which grazed the atmosphere's organic compounds. Deneva had a strong magnetic field that, in conjunction with it's closest moon, formed a dangerous ionic storm.<ref name="GSE" />

===Denbalen===
{{Main|Denbalen}}
The other of the system's gas giants, Denbalen, was similar to Deneva in appearance, but had a higher density and no magnetic fields. It orbited the sun at 67.2 light minutes. Although smaller than its sister world, Denbalen had a larger core, almost the size of Goroth Prime. One of its moons, [[P'Check]] contained the ruins of an extinct people.<ref name="GSE" />

===Goroth Beta===
{{Main|Goroth Beta}}
Goroth Beta was the most outward orbital body and a gas giant that never ignited into a star. Orbiting at 340.3 light minutes, it had some nuclear activity but was considered lifeless.<ref name="GSE" />
